Give it a one line pitch: Know what each gig is really worth.
What makes it special?: Sill is a real-time earnings dashboard for working musicians. Sync your gig calendar, see payouts, commute times, and expenses in one view. It automatically calculates your true hourly rate after travel and expenses. A Mapbox-based map shows which gigs are worth the drive. Local-first storage keeps your data in your browser.
Write your first comment: Hey Orynth, I built Sill because I was tired of taking gigs that paid well on paper but barely broke even after driving an hour each way. The true hourly rate calc changed how I book. It uses Mapbox to visualize commute overlays, so I can see at a glance which nights are actually worth it. Let me know what you think, especially if you play shows too.
